verdict.rationale: OpenCode says it works with 'any IDE that supports a terminal', so it can run as a TUI inside JetBrains' built-in terminal. However, the documented IDE features (split-terminal shortcut, file-reference insertion) are described only for VS Code and Cursor, and nothing shows interactive diffs or selected-code sharing in JetBrains. Missing for 10: a JetBrains plugin or integration, interactive in-IDE diff viewing, sharing selected code as context from JetBrains, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
